approved_scope.summary: a read-only producer of the Step 5 main_drift facts (capture-evidence / build) that emits the live_mergeability mapping accepted by the EXISTING build_step5_live_mergeability() and read by step5-terminal-gate, plus a limited real-runtime acceptance run by the main session
approved_scope.design_choice: a single new script: adding to adjudicate_vc_result.py (designed to start no subprocess, many historical pins) or route_loop_verdict_v2.py (pure by design, pinned) would break an invariant or force historical pin re-sync; no existing source is changed
not_approved: automatic impl-review-loop start or any automatic Step 1/2/4/5 dispatch
verdict publication or any Reviewer GitHub write
Step 5 Final Gate / LOOP_HANDOFF_RESULT_V1 production wiring
Bot / Broker / controlled pr_* / secret / permission changes
branch update, replay, push, force push, merge, auto-merge, Ready, Issue close

not_changed: D1-D16 historical manifests and source pins

fact_provenance.current_base_sha: live ref tip of the PR baseRefName; differing raw baseRefOid is kept separately and must be an ancestor with both commit objects present
fact_provenance.evidence_base_sha: base tip recorded by capture-evidence at evidence-collection time (not the GO base)
fact_provenance.allowed_paths_snapshot_base_sha: base_sha_at_snapshot of an eligible trusted GO (5 eligibility checks)
fact_provenance.allowed_paths: live linked Issue body Allowed Paths entries as written (read twice)
fact_provenance.latest_main_net_diff: git diff --name-only evidence_base..current_base in the target checkout (ancestor required)
fact_provenance.expected_old_sha: PR HEAD recorded by capture-evidence (the old ref)
fact_provenance.observed_old_sha: live PR head branch ref re-read in the same cycle
fact_provenance.semantic_ambiguity: real two-commit git merge-tree --write-tree oracle (current_base vs expected_old); only exit 0/1 reach the oracle; missing commits and execution errors fail before the consumer on fresh and drift paths

count_evidence: Measured with pytest --co and a real run; the runner independently verifies per-file counts and JUnit outcome. Fixture level only: a real temporary Git repository and an injected fake gh; the trusted GO is injected through the parser seam in most cases and a real GO comment (posted by the real ensure_contract_snapshot.py into the existing stateful fake gh) goes through the real parser and the real is_go_current in the dedicated cases; no real GitHub, no model call, no SubAgent dispatch.

runtime_acceptance.rule: Accepted only by the main session against the D17 Draft PR with real GitHub and a real checkout. Input generation, the real Reviewer verdict, the Step 5 real route / reason_code / reached terminal checks, and any production Final Gate are recorded separately. A fixture result is never a runtime PASS; an unreached terminal check stays UNVERIFIED and does not cancel the input-generation result.
commands: git fetch origin (preparation by the caller; recorded, never run by the producer)
(independent test-runner) run the literal current-contract VCs after checking capture-to-VC bindings
(main session) Agent(subagent_type=pr-reviewer) for one PR number and HEAD

residual_constraints: evidence_base_sha comes from record.base_sha (live tip at capture, with raw baseRefOid only in capture output and build provenance), not a LOOP_STATE evidence epoch; the main session must verify unchanged bindings through capture, build, GO check-only and independent VC launch, and block on changes or missing provenance; close timestamps alone do not prove correspondence

drift_rebind_attempts and max_drift_rebind_attempts are not produced (they stay at the policy default 0, so the concurrent-churn budget is not active) and reviewer_verdict, diff-summary and TEST_VERDICT conversion remain manual
git fetch is a caller-side preparation and is never run by the producer; git merge-tree may write tree objects to the object database, so this is not claimed as zero writes

the live PR HEAD moving between capture and build is passed through (expected_old_sha != observed_old_sha) so that the router returns expected_old_cas_mismatch; a change between the two samples inside one build is refused
the runtime on a PR whose base did not move exercises only the fresh path; the drift routes are fixture-only
fresh build reuses the same write-once record without changing its historical base; if a new evidence epoch is required, runtime recovery is BLOCKED, not an AC6 pass
the main session must establish the relationship between any reused evidence record and independent VC; the producer does not enforce that relationship
GO authority is checked again near the final live observation; this is not an atomic guarantee against later changes
fork PRs are refused on a strict isCrossRepository observation, even if the base repository has a head ref with the same name and SHA

Git subprocesses disable lazy fetch and replace objects; the exact read-only merge driver config check includes all effective scopes, cannot be redirected by GIT_CONFIG, and precedes merge-tree without claiming atomicity
artifact I/O failures are structured; write-once record filenames and checkout entries are protected, and only a temporary output created by the current build is cleaned up on failure
rollback: Revert the single D17 PR: it removes the producer, this manifest, the D17 test and the CI lane. No existing script, document or historical manifest is changed.
ci_binding: The i4-4d17-step5-main-drift-facts job runs this manifest through scripts/ci/run_stage1b1_tests.py and the full tests/stage_i4 directory; no new permissions, runner or secrets.
